title: 第9章 镇海，种仙
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

天工司，顾名思义，巧夺天工，乃是鉴天教炼器之所。

相比较炼丹等修行之艺，炼器是个苦差事。

诸般金铁，秘木灵矿，都极难熔炼，塑形更是麻烦，就算功成还需温养。

哪怕各般杂事都交给法阵、炼器童子去做，内门弟子只需做最关键的【篆灵】等事，但相比其余灵司，还是要辛苦一筹，终日和地火打交道。

此司还有名额，没有招满，在陆玄的意料之中。

除此之外，三盟司他也有所知晓，这是鉴天教、木华宗、大燕国，三方势力共同组建的一方灵司，专职处理三方势力的各项事宜。

但三教之念，各不相同，平日里明争暗斗不再少数，三盟司这些年已经逐渐成为三方“擦屁股”的一个闲职部门。

大事无需三盟司，小事三盟司也不屑处理。

对筑基之上的修士来说，此司或许还有几分可取之处，但对炼炁弟子而言，此司就像是一个“天坑岗位”，不适合新手。

“果然剩下来的都是无人问津的岗位……”

陆玄心中摇头。

不过这是没办法的事，他二次大醮，已经错过统招，自然不会有什么好岗位。

但最后的镇海司，他在蛰院之中却并未听闻，当下只能对林山海问道：“敢问执事，这镇海司是何灵司？弟子似乎并未听闻。”

林山海答道：“你未曾听闻，也是正常，这是此届新设立的灵司，专职处理东海海域诸般事宜。”

“这几年，东海灵机喷涌，海中精怪层出不穷，不断侵扰我教边界，但海中生灵，多有神异，与我教而言，倒也是一桩机缘，故此设立此司。”

“在九大灵司之中，此司待遇最是顶尖，比天律司和镇岳司还高上一筹，但需出海降妖、斩妖，颇有几分凶险，你要是想入此司，需慎重。”

林山海没有隐瞒，将镇海司之利弊尽数说了，由陆玄自己抉择。

“待遇顶尖，但需出海斩妖？”

陆玄眉头微微蹙起。

他虽然突破炼炁，但只不过刚刚迈入修行第二境，还是一个修行中的“孩童”。

一般而言，炼炁弟子最起码要修行到炼炁四重之后，才会外出试炼、斩妖。

毕竟擎岳州不安稳，就算是大教弟子，一旦走出山门庇佑之地，也有风险。

在没有一定实力之前，还是要韬光养晦。

天工司、三盟司，虽然辛苦一些，但总归是在山门之中，可以安稳修行，无虞风险。

“嗯？”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The Tiangong Division, as the name suggests, is the place where the Jiantian Sect refines weapons.

Compared with alchemy and other cultivation arts, weapon refining is a hard job.

All kinds of gold, iron, and secret wood spiritual minerals are extremely difficult to smelt, and shaping them is even more troublesome. Even if they are successful, they still need to be warmed and maintained.

Even if all the chores are left to the magic circle and weapon refining boys, and the inner disciples only need to do the most critical things such as [Sealing Spirits], they still have to work harder than other spirit divisions, dealing with earthly fire all day long.

There are still places in this department, but they are not full, which is as expected by Lu Xuan.

In addition, he also knew about the Three Alliances Division, which was a spiritual division jointly established by Jiantian Sect, Muhua Sect, and Dayan Kingdom to deal with various matters of the three factions.

However, the thoughts of the three religions are different, and there are not many open and covert fights on weekdays. In recent years, the Three Leagues Division has gradually become a part-time department that "wipes the buttocks" of the three parties.

There is no need for the Three Leagues Division to deal with major matters, and the Three Leagues Division does not bother to deal with small matters.

For monks who are above the foundation building, this department may have some merits, but for Qi refining disciples, this department is like a "sinkhole position" and is not suitable for novices.

"Sure enough, the remaining positions are all unfilled positions..."

Lu Xuan shook his head in his heart.

But there is nothing that can be done about it. He has already missed the general recruitment for his second big feast, so naturally he will not get any good positions.

But at the end of the Zhenhai Division, he had not heard about it in the dormitory. At that moment, he could only ask Lin Shanhai: "May I ask the deacon, is this Zhenhai Division He Lingsi? It seems that the disciple has not heard about it."

Lin Shanhai replied: "It's normal that you haven't heard of it. This is the newly established Ling Division this term, dedicated to handling various matters in the East China Sea."

"In the past few years, the East China Sea has been full of spiritual inspiration, and the sea spirits have emerged one after another, constantly invading the borders of our sect. However, the creatures in the sea are full of mystical powers. For our sect, this is an opportunity, so we established this department."

"Among the nine great spiritual divisions, this division has the best remuneration, even higher than Tianlu division and Zhenyue division. However, it requires going out to sea to subjugate and slay demons, which is quite dangerous. If you want to join this division, you need to be careful."

Lin Shanhai didn't hide anything. He explained all the pros and cons of Zhenhai Division, leaving it up to Lu Xuan to make his own decision.

"The treatment is top-notch, but you need to go to sea to kill monsters?"

Lu Xuan frowned slightly.

Although he has made a breakthrough in refining Qi, he has just entered the second level of cultivation and is still a "child" in cultivation.

Generally speaking, Qi refining disciples must practice at least to the fourth level of Qi refining before going out to practice and slay demons.

After all, Qingyue Province is not stable, and even the disciples of the great sect are in danger once they step out of the protection of the mountain gate.

Before you have a certain level of strength, you still have to hide your strength and bide your time.

Although Tiangong Division and Sanmeng Division are a bit harder, they are still in the mountain gate and can practice safely without any risk.

"Huh?"
